  nothing changed — there the two are ANDed into one set and nothing downstream asks which filter removed a hit. The
  comment now says the order is not load-bearing there, says why the pair a hundred lines away is, and records that it was
  mutation-checked rather than assumed. It's the same failure we've been trading fixes for all afternoon, just in prose:
  an unchecked claim hardening into a source comment a future reader treats as a constraint.
